title: Reduction Formulae, CAST and Trigonometric Identities
seo_title: Grade 11 Reduction Formulae and Identities Worksheets with Answers (CAPS Maths)
standard_text: Derive and use the identities tan θ = sin θ/cos θ, cos θ ≠ 0, and sin² θ + cos² θ = 1; derive the reduction formulae for sin(90° ± θ), cos(90° ± θ), sin(180° ± θ), cos(180° ± θ), tan(180° ± θ), sin(360° ± θ), cos(360° ± θ), tan(360° ± θ), sin(−θ), cos(−θ) and tan(−θ).
meta_desc: Free CAPS Grade 11 trigonometry worksheets: reduction formulae, CAST, exact values in all quadrants and the identities sin² θ + cos² θ = 1 and tan θ = sin θ/cos θ. 100 questions with memos.
body_html:
How to think about it

  • CAST: All are positive in quadrant 1, Sin in 2, Tan in 3, Cos in 4.
  • 180° ± θ and 360° ± θ keep the same ratio; only the sign may change.
  • 90° ± θ changes sin to cos and cos to sin.
  • sin(−θ) = −sin θ, cos(−θ) = cos θ. Identities: sin² θ + cos² θ = 1 and tan θ = sin θ ÷ cos θ.
